entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Omigod, you did it, Shiho![n]I knew you could!

entries.speaker: Shiho
entries.en: It's all thanks to you supporting me,[n]Ann. I really appreciate it.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Aw, I'm not the one who deserves the[n]credit—you kept up your best effort and[n]now you're finally being recognized!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: [fName]!? I can't believe it![n]Over here!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Talk about a coincidence! It's been[n]a while since the last time you saw[n]Shiho, right?

entries.speaker: Shiho
entries.en: Long time no see, [lName]-kun.[n]Do you remember me?
Shiho Suzui, right?
How have you been?

entries.speaker: Shiho
entries.en: Wow, you remembered me?

entries.speaker: Shiho
entries.en: We didn't even get to talk all that much[n]since I transferred to another school so[n]early into the semester.

entries.speaker: Shiho
entries.en: I've been well, thank you for asking.[n]I'm surprised you remembered, though.

entries.speaker: Shiho
entries.en: We didn't even get to talk all that much[n]since I transferred to another school so[n]early into the semester.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Of course he remembers you!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: He HAS to remember, what with the[n]bragging—I've told him all about[n]how amazing my BFF is at volleyball.

entries.speaker: Shiho
entries.en: Oh, Ann...

entries.speaker: Shiho
entries.en: Sorry you have to put up with all that,[n][lName]-kun.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Shiho was the MVP at the big meet[n]the other day too.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Not only was she in the starting lineup,[n]but she scored more points than[n]anybody else!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No wonder she's the star of the team![n]I'm just so proud of you, Shiho!

entries.speaker: Shiho
entries.en: Aw, you're too much...
The two of them are[n]beaming with joy...
It seems this reality is the[n]one that Ann wished for...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh yeah, I forgot to mention—Shiho's[n]coming back to our school!

entries.speaker: Shiho
entries.en: Everyone in volleyball knows that[n]Shujin's the top school when it comes[n]to the sport.

entries.speaker: Shiho
entries.en: That's how I was able to convince my[n]parents to let me transfer back... after[n]more than a little begging.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I was so sad when she transferred[n]for her parents' jobs, but all's well[n]that ends well!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I feel like everything's just perfect!
Are you happy with Shiho now?
Is it everything you wished for?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh? What does that mean?[n]Of course I am...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh? What I wished for...?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, I guess you could say so...
Do you prefer things this way?
Any doubts about it?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: This... way? I mean, both you and Shiho[n]are here, and everything's going great...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's definitely better than the alternative,[n]like when we... Wait, huh? I...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wh-What do you mean, "any doubts"?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, I know I don't. I spent so much time[n]worrying over everything that now I've—[n]Wait... What?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Something is... I remember being so[n]cornered that I just wanted to die,[n]but then I met everyone, and...
Keep thinking on it.
I'll be waiting for you.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What does that—

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Shiho's still alive even after all the things[n]that made her want to die!
entries.uk: Сіхо досі жива — навіть після всього, що[n]змусило її хотіти смерті!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You have no right to run from this!
entries.uk: Ти не маєш права від цього втекти!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh!? I just...

entries.speaker: Shiho
entries.en: Ann, what's wrong? Are you okay?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, um, I'm fine! I think I'm just...[n]feeling a bit tired?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Why don't we go find some place[n]to sit and relax for a bit?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Sorry, [fName]! I'll call you later...

entries.speaker: Shiho
entries.en: See you, [lName]-kun.
...It seems all I can[n]do now is wait.
I guess I should head home...
